hook_patterns: Open with a personal mistake or social pain the viewer already feels
Use How/Why titles that promise a usable behavior change
Lead with a named social skill or red flag in the first sentence
Put a bold on-screen claim in the first 1 second
Challenge a common belief about confidence, dating, or attachment
tone: Direct, coach-like, respectful. Specific behavior language. No medical diagnosis or cure claims.
pacing: Hook text in first second. Spoken claim by second 2. One idea per Short. Caption every phrase. Cut or visual change every 2-4 seconds.
structure: Pain hook → one mechanism → one concrete behavior tip → reframe → soft CTA
forbidden: How to Read the Moment Without Guessing

video_ideas.title: How to deal with insults without looking weak
Why constant reassurance keeps anxiety alive
The tiny signal that reveals flirting anxiety
How toxic people use covert control
Why one pause on a first date feels huge
How to turn awkwardness into confidence
The scary mistake most advice-givers make
How to stop second-guessing every text

script_instructions: Front-load the subject. Keep titles under ~70 chars when possible. Use How/Why. Burned-in captions must be large and high-contrast. Prefer one face or one clean illustration style, not mixed collage chaos.

shorts: Vertical talking-head or clean illustrated panel
Top title card in first second (bold claim)
Warm practical lighting or flat high-contrast graphic backgrounds
visual_dna.thumbnail_style: Face emotion or simple graphic + 3-5 word claim; high contrast
